title: Temporary pixel mapping for the hydrology audit
status: internal working reference; not an official geographic registration

official_full_superbig.formula: X=12*x+5.5; Y=12*y+5.5 (pixel centers; top-left origin; x right; y down)

control_points.method: SIFT matches on non-water detail after reducing the 8192x5792 full map to 2048x1448

official_clean_superbig.note: Three extra columns occur at the far right edge; national features are registered using the 8193x5792 clean working raster.

coordinate_system.latitude_type: custom latitude scaled from planetographic latitude
coordinate_system.longitude_domain_convention: [-180, 180); 360 degrees for one complete turn around Saturn

prime_meridian.definition: Local project meridian through the capital, not Saturn System III

projection.name: Ellipsoidal Cylindrical Equal-Area (CEA)
projection.purpose: Area-preserving conversion from official-map image pixels to the custom Saturn longitude/latitude frame
projection.anchor_rationale: A non-round, approximate northern-subtropical placement chosen as a worldbuilding fit for southern agriculture and western aridity; these climate clues do not uniquely determine latitude.

custom_coordinate_reference.interpretation: Temporary project Saturn coordinates derived from input_map pixels; not official map coordinates or WGS 84.

official_river_superbig.formula: X=12*x+5.5; Y=12*y+5.5 (input_map pixel coordinates; top-left origin; x right; y down)
official_river_superbig.relationship: 3x expansion of the 8193x5792 4x working raster; shares the project pixel coordinate grid
official_river_superbig.registration_check: locally verified by overlaying centerline skeletons from the official river raster on the existing vector network; not a geographic CRS or absolute geodetic registration

official_border_superbig.formula: X=12*x+5.5; Y=12*y+5.5 (input_map pixel coordinates; top-left origin; x right; y down)
official_border_superbig.relationship: 3x expansion of the 8193x5792 4x working raster; shares the project pixel coordinate grid
official_border_superbig.registration_check: locally verified by overlaying centerline skeletons from the official river raster on the existing vector network; not a geographic CRS or absolute geodetic registration

current_followup_reference.method: 12x official river-only raster for river/canal centerlines and lake water outlines; official boundary super raster for coast/mouth context
current_followup_reference.note: The 0.16 px simplification tolerance describes vectorization tolerance only, not absolute geographic accuracy.
